topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
response: LEO satellites have smaller aperture sizes due to lower orbit altitudes, allowing for higher gain and portability in CMOS-based ground terminals. GEO satellites require larger apertures for comparable gains.
reference_context: SatCom systems involve LEO and GEO satellites with varying antenna gains, such as 45 dBi at 29 GHz and 42 dBi at 19 GHz, affecting link performance.
